external_data.name: EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit, All-causes pre-departure delay (airport, day), as in v48
external_data.terms: as recorded in configs/daily_totals_v1.json (not an open licence); used on the user's decision recorded there
external_data.definition: docs/scout/published_definition.json: DLY_ALL_PRE_2 x 60 = sum over departures of max(round((block - schedule) / 60), 0) x 60 on every equal-count 2025 day at EGLL, LIRF, EDDM, LEMD, LTFM, LFPG, LEBL; EHAM, LSZH, LEBL count IFR departures only

procedure.position: a layer after v48's procedure (configs/daily_totals_v1.json, unchanged): v48 reconciles every read airport-day as before; on the days this layer selects, the rows v48 moved that enter the published figure take v48's value minus v48's day shift plus beta_a * I_d
procedure.implied_shift: I_d = -(published - c0_a - sum over in-figure rows of max(a - prediction, 0)) / n_eff, n_eff = in-figure rows with a > prediction; in-figure = every departure except non-IFR rows at EHAM, LSZH, LEBL
procedure.fitted_on_fitting_days: c0_a = median(published - own total of the labels); over days with dn = 0 (published count = in-figure rows) and n_eff >= 100: corr_a and the least-squares slope through zero beta_a of the day's mean residual (label - prediction) of in-figure, v48-moved, non-extra rows with |residual| < 1800 s, on I_d; beta clipped to [0, 1]
procedure.calibrated_airports: corr_a >= 0.9 over at least 30 fitting days
procedure.days_changed: |I_d| >= 80 s, n_eff >= 100, published total present, and dn = 0 or sign-safe: dn > 0 with published below implied, or dn < 0 with published above implied (missing flights can only raise the published total, extra rows only the implied total)
procedure.fitting_side: development read: for each month, the other three development months (v46 stack, declared v48 run); twelve-month check: the other eleven months (v23-recipe predictor, v48's procedure on that table = runs/daily_totals/check12f); ranking: all four development months
procedure.free_parameters: none fitted on scores or on the scored months

rule.text: accepted when (1) no development month is worse than v48 by more than 0.005% of its RMSE, (2) the mean change over the equal-footing months is at least 0.02% below zero, (3) the development month with the largest gain has its paired-day 95% interval (by off-block day, seed 20260929) below zero, (4) in the twelve-month check no month is worse by more than 0.005% and at least half of the months the layer changes are better. A sparse layer cannot meet v48's 'every equal-footing interval below zero': months without an extreme day do not change. November is reported in (1).
